Interface MediaViewerComponent

All Known Implementing Classes:
JavaFxMediaViewerImpl, MediaRenderer.GenericMediaCard, SwingAudioViewer, SwingImageViewer
public interface MediaViewerComponent
Universal interface for multimodal media viewer components across the Swing UI.

Unifies the visual rendering and interaction lifecycle for images, audio, and video across chat message parts (BlobPartPanel), tool attachments (ToolResponseAttachmentsPanel), and managed context resources (ResourcePanel).

    • load

      void load(byte[] data, String mimeType, String displayName, URI sourceUri)
      Loads and initializes the media data for display and playback.
      Parameters:
      data - The raw binary data.
      mimeType - The detected MIME type (e.g. "video/mp4", "image/png", "audio/wav").
      displayName - An optional human-readable name or file name for the media item.
      sourceUri - An optional source URI on disk or remote network.
